content.user_title: Design Mobile Apps for Real Devices
content.value_statement: Mobile apps often fail when desktop patterns drive touch, performance, and platform choices. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through mobile-first decisions for iOS, Android, React Native, and Flutter.
actual_capabilities: Guides platform and framework selection using decision trees for iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, and native builds.
Defines touch targets, thumb zones, gestures, haptics, and accessibility checks for mobile interfaces.
Provides performance rules for lists, animations, memory, battery, and network behavior.
Explains mobile backend patterns for offline sync, push notifications, auth storage, versioning, and monitoring.
Includes a Python audit script that flags common React Native and Flutter implementation issues.
Separates iOS Human Interface Guidelines from Android Material Design patterns.
limitations: It is guidance, not a visual component library or generated design system.
It does not replace testing on real iOS and Android devices.
The audit script uses pattern checks and can miss context-specific problems.
It does not provide production-ready backend services or credentials.

use_cases.title: Plan a mobile product
use_cases.description: Use decision trees to choose framework, navigation, storage, offline strategy, and platform scope before design starts.

use_cases.title: Review implementation choices
use_cases.description: Check React Native, Flutter, iOS, or Android screens for touch, performance, navigation, and accessibility risks.

use_cases.title: Prepare release readiness
use_cases.description: Build a release checklist for device testing, offline behavior, secure storage, monitoring, and platform-specific quality.

prompt_templates.title: Start a mobile feature
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new mobile screen or flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the mobile-design skill to plan this feature. Ask me for platform, framework, navigation, offline needs, devices, and audience before giving recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Review a screen concept
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of an existing idea or wireframe.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this mobile screen concept for touch targets, thumb zones, navigation fit, accessibility, and platform expectations. Give separate iOS and Android notes.

prompt_templates.title: Choose mobile architecture
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for a cross-platform app.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare React Native, Flutter, SwiftUI, and Compose for this product. Include performance, team skills, offline needs, release process, and platform divergence.

prompt_templates.title: Audit before release
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release review for a built app.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this mobile implementation before release. Cover lists, animations, memory, battery, backend behavior, secure storage, platform testing, and accessibility.

output_examples.input: Review a checkout screen for a React Native shopping app.
output_examples.output: The response scores feasibility, checks thumb-zone placement, flags missing offline recovery, and separates iOS swipe behavior from Android back behavior.

output_examples.input: Plan navigation for a productivity app on phones and tablets.
output_examples.output: The response compares tabs, stacks, drawer navigation, and navigation rail options, then recommends platform-specific patterns with release checks.

output_examples.input: Audit a Flutter list screen before release.
output_examples.output: The response checks list virtualization, const widgets, targeted rebuilds, image memory, font scaling, touch targets, and device testing coverage.

best_practices: State platform, framework, navigation, offline needs, devices, and audience before asking for design work.
Ask for separate iOS and Android decisions when navigation, gestures, typography, or system components differ.
Validate touch, performance, accessibility, offline, and security concerns before treating visuals as final.
anti_patterns: Asking for a generic mobile layout without platform, device, or audience constraints.
Using desktop interaction patterns such as hover, small targets, dense toolbars, or unlimited text.
Treating React Native, Flutter, iOS, and Android as interchangeable implementation targets.

faq.question: Does this skill generate app screens?
faq.answer: It guides screen structure and decisions. It is not a finished UI kit or asset generator.

faq.question: Which frameworks does it support?
faq.answer: It covers React Native, Flutter, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, and native iOS or Android decisions.

faq.question: Can it audit existing code?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a pattern-based Python audit script and detailed review checklists for mobile implementation risks.

faq.question: Does it replace Apple or Google documentation?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes practical mobile rules and should be checked against current platform documentation when needed.

faq.question: Can it help with mobile backend design?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers offline sync, push notifications, secure token storage, versioning, media handling, and mobile monitoring.

faq.question: Is it enough for production release decisions?
faq.answer: Use it as structured guidance. Confirm results with real device testing, accessibility review, and platform-specific QA.
